intermediate.title: Sprint | 1st passage of the finish line (117.2 km)

story: A four-rider breakaway formed immediately after the start. Crosswinds on the exposed roads of the Lammermuir Hills later split the peloton, allowing five UAE Team Emirates-XRG riders, including race leader Tim Wellens, to form the decisive front group. With Lewis Askey caught behind, UAE exploited its numerical advantage and launched several attacks. Nils Politt made the decisive move with 9 km remaining and won solo ahead of Florian Vermeersch and Filippo Ganna, while Wellens secured the overall title.
